channel.title: News Today — Smart AI News Portal
channel.description: বাংলাদেশ, ভারত ও বিশ্বের সর্বশেষ খবর — স্বয়ংক্রিয়ভাবে আপডেটেড

item.title: Contrasting contenders in Brazil presidential vote
item.description: Rio de Janeiro correspondent Ione Wells notes that Sunday's election features two distinct choices for voters. The presidential race pits these contrasting figures against each other.

item.title: Brighton defeats West Ham following Symonds goal
item.description: Maisie Symonds netted a stunning goal to lead Brighton to a 3-0 victory against West Ham. This performance earned the team their second Women's Super League win this season.

item.title: Antonelli captures pole position at US event
item.description: Kimi Antonelli claimed the top starting spot for the United States Grand Prix. He enters the weekend with an opportunity to secure his maiden world championship.

item.title: Trump casts ballot in Palm Beach voting center
item.description: Donald Trump and First Lady Melania Trump voted at a West Palm Beach polling location in Palm Beach County. Earlier, the president visited a nearby golf club before heading to cast his ballot.

item.title: Overview of various digital wallet options
item.description: Digital payment tools eliminate the necessity for physical cash and cards. Beyond popular platforms like Apple, Samsung, and Google, numerous other variations exist.

item.title: Bird with coded band and foreign cash found in Jammu
item.description: Authorities discovered a pigeon near a Samba temple carrying Pakistani currency and a ring with coded markings. Officials noted that border regions frequently encounter birds used for cross-frontier messaging or smuggling.

item.title: Huge crowds attend final rallies ahead of Brazil vote
item.description: Massive gatherings formed for the final campaign events of the presidential run-off. Sunday's decisive ballot will decide if the nation retains its leftist administration or pivots rightward.

item.title: Brazilian presidential contenders stage final events
item.description: The final campaign rallies concluded ahead of a tightly contested presidential run-off in Brazil. Voters will soon decide between the competing candidates in the pivotal election.

item.title: Dalton Smith Defends WBC Title Against Alberto Puello
item.description: British boxer Dalton Smith successfully defended his WBC light-welterweight world belt in Sheffield. He secured the victory via a split decision against Alberto Puello during his homecoming bout.

item.title: Iran Criticizes US Over Nuclear Accord and Warns of Retaliation
item.description: Tehran has pointed to Washington as the reason for the breakdown of negotiations and called for fresh diplomatic talks. Iranian officials also cautioned that any restricted military strikes would prompt a much larger counterattack.

item.title: Early Reactions Emerge for Upcoming Film 'Ramayana: Part 1'
item.description: The upcoming movie 'Ramayana: Part 1', starring Ranbir Kapoor and Yash, is scheduled for a November 5, 2026 release. Early feedback highlights strong emotional elements and notable visual effects, with the English cut being shorter than the Hindi version.

item.title: Weighing the Benefits and Drawbacks of eSIM Technology
item.description: While digital eSIM cards offer greater ease of use compared to traditional physical SIM cards, they do not represent a complete upgrade in every single aspect.

item.title: Michael Carrick States Manchester United Is Manageable
item.description: Ahead of Sunday's fixture against Bournemouth at Old Trafford, Michael Carrick asserted that leading Manchester United is a manageable task while his own position remains under pressure.

item.title: Nearly 1,000 Detained Amid Nationwide Demonstrations in France
item.description: Authorities across France detained close to 1,000 individuals as hundreds of thousands participated in widespread protests. Officials managed to prevent the severe looting and rioting seen during the previous weekend.

item.title: BBC Retains Imperfect Footage in Upcoming 'Blue Planet III'
item.description: To demonstrate genuine authenticity in the era of artificial intelligence, the BBC's 'Blue Planet III' will retain less-than-perfect camera shots. Earlier nature series relied on flawless, highly polished footage that often appeared artificial.

item.title: Researchers Correct Date of 155-Year-Old Solar Storm Event
item.description: Archival researchers have corrected a historical mix-up regarding a solar storm-linked train delay in Exeter, establishing that the incident occurred on October 18, 1848.

item.title: Houthi Missile Strikes Hit Aden And Other Yemeni Locations
item.description: Yemeni sites, including the Aden airport and a coastguard facility, were reportedly hit by Houthi projectiles.

item.title: Ukraine confirms stable Starlink operations following earlier limits
item.description: Ukrainian officials reported reliable Starlink satellite connectivity roughly ten days after experiencing operational limits. President Volodymyr Zelenskyy expressed gratitude to American partners for re-establishing the network vital for frontline logistics and air defense.

item.title: Trump Casts Early Midterm Vote In Florida
item.description: The president voted early in Florida for the midterms. Regarding the conflict involving Iran, he stated he might need to conclude it or await a possible agreement.

item.title: Court Denies Dallas Couple's Larger Insurance Claim
item.description: An appeals court dismissed a $58,150 lawsuit against State Farm over 2021 freeze damage, ruling it missed the policy deadline after a prior $4,261 payout.

item.title: Tottenham Reaches 12th Place Following Honest Discussion
item.description: Following a candid internal meeting, Tottenham finished Saturday holding 12th position in the Premier League standings.

item.title: Train Hits Fallen Crane On Brazilian Railway
item.description: Footage captured a train striking a crane that had dropped onto the tracks in Brazil.

item.title: Gaza Faces Severe Food Shortages As Bakeries Shut
item.description: Residents in Gaza face extreme hunger as local bakeries lack the necessary flour to produce bread.

item.title: Tens of thousands rally for Lula ahead of Brazil vote
item.description: Massive crowds of supporters gathered on a prominent Rio de Janeiro beach before Sunday's presidential runoff election. Approximately 159 million citizens are eligible to vote in the race.

item.title: Houthi Forces Target Saudi Sites And Aden Following Raids
item.description: Yemeni fighters reported striking three Saudi airfields, energy sites, a pipeline, and an air base within a 24-hour period.

item.title: Starlink Service Restored And Functioning In Ukraine
item.description: Satellite internet service Starlink appeared to resume normal operations in Ukraine. This followed reports that SpaceX had previously restricted access.

item.title: Albanian police clash with demonstrators on twelfth protest day
item.description: Law enforcement and demonstrators engaged in street battles during the twelfth consecutive day of anti-establishment demonstrations across Albania.

item.title: West Bank lockdown planned by Israel following Hebron shooting
item.description: Israel is organizing a complete closure of the occupied West Bank in the wake of a shooting incident in Hebron.

item.title: Piyush Goyal discusses strategies to bring Indian researchers home
item.description: Following a Berlin meeting with Indian academics on Friday, Piyush Goyal stated that building a supportive innovation ecosystem is vital. He plans to address this matter with administrative bodies and academic institutions.

item.title: Madras High Court permits life-term prisoners 40 days yearly leave
item.description: Justices Anita Sumanth and Sunder Mohan ruled that correctional facilities are prohibited from forcing inmates to take their annual leave all at once, allowing it in two blocks.

item.title: Nanganallur pavement alterations noted by local resident
item.description: Resident B. Ramachandran reported that ramps were installed along a stretch of Sixth Main Road in Nanganallur to aid vehicle access and parking.

item.title: Local reader calls for expansion of Pammal Road
item.description: Reader Rajagopal J K pointed out that Pammal Road has gone without expansion for forty years and urgently requires widening.

item.title: Indian Railways introduces low-cost travel insurance policy
item.description: Counter ticket purchasers can now secure coverage up to Rs 10 lakh for 45 paise, including payouts for disabilities, medical care, and body transport.

item.title: Students avoid injury after tree collapse near Ashok Nagar school
item.description: Mohammed Yusufdeen submitted a reader report about a fallen tree near an Ashok Nagar school, emphasizing that students narrowly escaped harm and urging regular pruning.

item.title: Man Reports 10-Hour Floor Wait for 93-Year-Old Mother's Ambulance
item.description: Graham Anthony stated that his 93-year-old mother, Margaret Owen, endured a ten-hour wait on the floor for medical transport while crying out in agony.

item.title: Suspected Illicit Alcohol Deaths Reported in Madhya Pradesh
item.description: More than ten fatalities are suspected from toxic liquor in a Madhya Pradesh district, though local authorities dispute the claim. Congress leader Jitu Patwari criticized the state administration over recurring mass casualty incidents.

item.title: CBI Charges IL&FS Energy and Executives in Bank Fraud Case
item.description: The CBI lodged an FIR on October 21 against IL&FS Energy Development Company Ltd, several senior executives, and unidentified individuals over an alleged Rs 212 crore Canara Bank loan scam.

item.title: Artificial Intelligence and Vulnerable Web Infrastructure
item.description: Experts examine whether emerging artificial intelligence technologies will reveal deep structural vulnerabilities within the current internet framework.

item.title: Liverpool and Other Clubs Monitor Defender Luka Vuskovic
item.description: Several prominent football clubs, including Liverpool, are reportedly monitoring Brighton defender Luka Vuskovic. Meanwhile, AC Milan is said to have set its sights on Manchester United player Leny Yoro.

item.title: Baltimore Property Flips for $310K Before Foreclosure Listing
item.description: A Baltimore home sold for $310,000 a year after a $43,000 purchase is now listed at $35,000 following foreclosure. The dramatic price shift has sparked federal lawsuits and accusations of investor-driven valuation inflation.

item.title: Bay of Bengal low-pressure system triggers rain alerts across Andhra Pradesh
item.description: A developing low-pressure system over the Bay of Bengal has prompted the Andhra Pradesh State Disaster Management Authority to issue rainfall warnings. Several districts, including Konaseema, Krishna, and Guntur, are expected to receive wet weather.

item.title: Danielle Parton Shares Dolly Parton's Reaction to Cancer Diagnosis
item.description: Danielle Parton shared that her aunt Dolly Parton was devastated upon learning of her stage zero cancer diagnosis, which was detected early.

item.title: France Sees Mass Rallies Over Cost of Living and Security Clashes
item.description: Hundreds of thousands demonstrated across France on Saturday to protest living expenses. Protests in Paris and other cities began peacefully before escalating into clashes and drawing a strong security response.

item.title: Enforcement Directorate challenges High Court ruling in Supreme Court
item.description: Roughly five months after a May 29 High Court decision, the ED has filed an appeal. The agency argues that the delay in releasing the verdict breached Supreme Court guidelines.

item.title: ফ্রান্সে বিক্ষোভের জেরে বাণিজ্যিক প্রতিষ্ঠান ও পর্যটন কেন্দ্র বন্ধ
item.description: ফ্রান্সজুড়ে শুরু হওয়া বিক্ষোভের কারণে বিভিন্ন দোকান ও পর্যটন স্পট বন্ধ রাখা হয়েছে। পরিস্থিতি নিয়ন্ত্রণে দেশটিতে ৭০ হাজার নিরাপত্তা কর্মী মোতায়েন করা হয়েছে এবং ইউরোপের অন্য কয়েকটি দেশেও প্রতিবাদের সম্ভাবনা রয়েছে।

item.title: Arsenal ties Manchester City atop Premier League as Tottenham defeats Chelsea
item.description: Arsenal advanced to the league lead following Manchester City's initial defeat of the term. Meanwhile, Tottenham secured their second away victory against Chelsea in 36 years.

item.title: Delhi traders ask Rahul Gandhi to postpone rally to protect festival commerce
item.description: The CTI requested a delay for a November 1 rally to prevent disrupting Dhanteras sales, noting prior October road closures caused billions in commercial losses. The BJP also criticized the Congress.

item.title: Sachin Pilot critiques AAP governance and discusses Punjab political landscape
item.description: Sachin Pilot stated that AAP failed to curb drugs and crime during its tenure. He added that Punjab politics is shifting toward a bipolar contest amid structural changes in regional parties.

item.title: Demonstrators and Paris police clash amid evening unrest
item.description: Initial daytime demonstrations in Paris turned confrontational after dark, leading riot police to deploy tear gas against protesters amidst fireworks.

item.title: Supreme Court rules voters can directly sue election candidates for false details
item.description: Justices Dipankar Datta and Sheel Nagu overturned a Karnataka High Court ruling, deciding that voters are not required to seek Election Commission approval to file private criminal complaints.

item.title: Rangers rebound with dominant performance against St Johnstone
item.description: Following a frustrating draw at Dundee, manager Derek McInnes called for a strong reaction from his Rangers squad. The team responded decisively by defeating St Johnstone with strong forward play.

item.title: Eleven-year-old Bodhana Sivanandan achieves International Master title
item.description: Living in Harrow, London, eleven-year-old Bodhana Sivanandan secured her final-round victory at the European Women's Club Cup. She surpassed a 38-year-old chess record previously set by Judit Polgar.

item.title: Musk Restricts Ukraine Starlink Following Trump Remarks
item.description: Billionaire Elon Musk restricted Ukraine's usage of the Starlink military network. This decision followed Donald Trump's criticism regarding Ukrainian attacks on Russian energy sites.

item.title: Election Commission Orders Re-poll in Agra Teachers Constituency
item.description: Following widespread complaints, the election authority mandated fresh voting at three booths in the Agra Teachers MLC constituency. SP candidate Akash Agarwal had previously reported severe intimidation of his supporters during the Uttar Pradesh legislative polls.

item.title: রোটারি ইন্টারন্যাশনাল কর্তৃক ঢাকায় বিশ্ব পোলিও দিবস পালিত
item.description: বিশ্ব পোলিও দিবসে ঢাকায় আয়োজিত র‍্যালিতে পোলিও দূর করার বার্তা প্রচার করা হয়। অনুষ্ঠানে শিশু immunization কর্মসূচি জোরদার ও জনসচেতনতা তৈরির ওপর জোর দেওয়া হয়।

item.title: Vanessa Trump declares recovery from cancer half a year after news
item.description: Vanessa Trump, former spouse of Donald Trump Jr. and mother of five, stated she is free of cancer six months after her initial breast cancer disclosure in May.

item.title: Andhra Pradesh Prepares for Severe Cyclonic Storm Landfall
item.description: Meteorologists predict a severe cyclone with winds reaching 130 kmph to make landfall between Bapatla and Vizag on October 28. The IMD has issued a red alert for 13 districts across October 27 and 28.

item.title: Israelis Protest Netanyahu Government Days Prior to Vote
item.description: Demonstrators gathered in Tel Aviv to oppose the current administration. Opposition leaders participated, calling for an independent investigation into October 7.

item.title: Kerala Releases Funds for Social Security and Welfare Pensions
item.description: The state administration of Kerala approved ₹1,081 crore to disburse social security and welfare board pensions. Payments are scheduled to begin on October 26.

item.title: Tottenham Defeats Chelsea at Stamford Bridge as Palmer Sees Red
item.description: Tottenham secured a rare 2-0 away win against Chelsea, marking only their second victory at the venue in 36 years. The hosts played with ten men following Cole Palmer's dismissal.
